summary: Wave 2+ backend & frontend tested end-to-end. 35/35 pytest cases pass covering Companies (create, list, filter by vertical, slug lookup, patch 403/200, follow toggle+counter, soft-delete), Jobs (owner-only create 403 for non-owner, list public, apply, duplicate apply 409, applications owner-only, status update, /me/applications), Events (company ownership 403, personal event without company, upcoming_only, RSVP going→attendees+1, toggle-off, going→interested reassigns counters), Profile (GET/PATCH persistence, providers[], public profile), Analytics (summary admin-only with all required keys + 401/403 for non-admin, timeseries admin-only), and analytics events (company.created, job.applied, event.rsvp, user.profile_update). Frontend Playwright verified: /empresas, /empleos, /eventos, /perfil all render with expected testids; company create modal creates a company that appears in the list; follow toggle increments '0 seguidores' → '1 seguidor'; profile editor persists headline. Anonymous: companies-create-btn hidden and feed-composer-locked visible on /.
action_items: No blockers. Wave 2 is functional end-to-end.
Nice-to-have: /api/analytics/summary.totals also includes 'shares' and 'saves' (not required by spec but present — worth documenting).
Nice-to-have: consider adding a small integration test for the /api/events?upcoming_only=false path (currently the list defaults filter past events, which is per spec).
critical_code_review_comments: event_routes.py:242 — the counter-diff logic (`upd[k] = upd.get(k, 0) + v`) works because the two `_inc()` calls return single-key dicts with distinct keys; if the mapping ever adds more statuses that share the same field, this line will silently sum wrong. Add a unit test or make it explicit.

company_routes.py:96 — `isinstance(doc.get('social'), object)` is always True for any non-None value. It happens to work because it then checks `hasattr(...,'model_dump')`, but the isinstance test is redundant. Minor.
profile_routes.py:32 — providers extraction silently drops entries without 'provider' key; fine, but worth logging in dev if you ever expect providers to have shape mismatches.

analytics_routes.py timeseries — filters out rows with 'vertical' or 'country' via post-fetch condition; consider excluding at the query level (`vertical: {$exists: false}`) for a cheaper query on large collections.

profile_routes.py:63 — PATCH /me does not enforce that arrays are size-bounded (skills, specialties, verticals, languages, interests). Consider max_length on the pydantic List fields to prevent an attacker from writing huge documents.
